name: Ceallach

attributes.attribute: the older spelling of the name Ceallach

text: Ceallach is the modern spelling of Cellach. The name denotes the same Irish legendary figure. Cellach stands among the heroes of Irish legend. Tradition makes him a son of Cormac mac Airt. The older form of the name carries the tales about this hero.

okr.objective: Ceallach is the modern form of the name of Cellach, an Irish legendary hero.
key_results: Ceallach is the modern spelling of the name Cellach.
Cellach ranks as a hero in Irish legend.
Cellach is a son of Cormac mac Airt.
